accident_report:
Vehicle Initialization
On a one-way three-lane urban expressway, the road curves gently to the right. The lanes are numbered from right to left as Lane 1, Lane 2, and Lane 3, with Lane 3 adjacent to a continuous concrete barrier. Light rain is present, resulting in reduced visibility and a wet, low-friction surface.
V1 is traveling in Lane 2, positioned mid-traffic, with an initial speed of 82 km/h, maintaining steady motion and intending to follow the leading vehicle.
V2 is ahead of V1 in Lane 2 at a distance of approximately 28 meters, traveling at 78 km/h with a steady cruising intent.
V4 is in Lane 3, approximately 22 meters ahead-left of V1, traveling at 80 km/h and maintaining its lane through the curve.
Scene Development
As the vehicles enter the right-hand curve, forward visibility is compressed due to road geometry, reducing the distance at which drivers can perceive downstream traffic. Light rain introduces atmospheric mist, further degrading visual clarity.
V2 begins to decelerate to 70 km/h due to fluctuations in upstream traffic. Because of the محدود sight distance and reduced visibility, V1 fails to detect this deceleration in time. When the gap closes to approximately 18 meters, V1 recognizes the سرعت difference and initiates emergency braking.
On the wet road surface, reduced tire-road friction significantly increases braking distance and induces slight yaw instability in V1. To avoid rear-end collision with V2, V1 attempts a leftward steering maneuver. However, under low-grip conditions, lateral stability deteriorates, and the vehicle drifts toward Lane 3.
V4, traveling in Lane 3 at 80 km/h, also experiences delayed perception due to the curve and rain. Upon detecting V1’s lateral intrusion, V4 applies emergency braking and attempts a slight leftward adjustment. However, the rigid concrete barrier immediately to its left eliminates any effective lateral escape path.
Under combined braking and steering inputs on the low-friction surface, V1 develops pronounced lateral slip. The rear swings right while the front continues leftward, resulting in full encroachment into Lane 3 and rapid approach toward V4.
Result
The first collision occurs when the front-left of V1 impacts the right side of V4 in Lane 3. The collision takes place adjacent to the concrete barrier, which prevents lateral energy dissipation and amplifies impact severity.
This outcome is the result of interacting risk factors: delayed hazard perception due to road curvature, reduced visibility from rain, diminished friction affecting braking and stability, and the limited escape space caused by the rigid barrier. After the collision, Lanes 2 and 3 are partially blocked, forcing following vehicles to slow down and creating traffic disruption with potential secondary risks.
